usedFor: Shopify holds the catalog and orders, and ChatBot receives conversation flows through “Create a Story”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Product” in Shopify, then “Create a Story” in ChatBot
bestTemplate.why: Each new product gets its own story, so the chatbot has a flow ready for it.

watchOut: “Create a Story” only makes a new story, so a changed product needs “Update Story” instead.
